diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.384), which favours a weighted combination.

test a trimmed mean to see if trimming outlier models improves over median, given strong seasonal trend and low predictability.
The ranking stability is moderate and several models are highly correlated; a diversity‑aware DBA may capture complementary patterns.
test a weighted strategy with softmax_neg_error to see if a smooth weighting improves over inverse_error and median, given moderate ranking stability and strong trend/seasonality.
testing a simple mean of the full pool to see if an unweighted average outperforms the weighted approaches given the high correlation groups.
Trying a per‑horizon one‑hot weighted combination (best_per_horizon) to see if different models dominate at different lags, given the strong seasonal cycle and moderate ranking stability.
The series has moderate ranking stability but many correlated groups; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture complementary strengths across horizons.
try a weighted combination using error trend to capture models that improve over windows; the series has moderate ranking stability and low predictability, so trend‑based weighting may help.
The series shows moderate ranking stability and strong correlation groups; a Caruana forward selection as weights may capture complementary models better than fixed inverse or softmax.
The series has strong trend/seasonality but low predictability; the best models are the top 5 in RMSE. Testing a mean of just those top performers may reduce noise from weaker, correlated models.
Test a weighted combination on the low‑variance pool4 using softmax_neg_error to see if a smooth weight improves over the mean, given the moderate ranking stability and strong seasonal trend.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9192. Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.384); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.032.
